title: Dervish armor
wikitext:
{{TOCright}}
A full set of [[Dervish]] armor consists of a hood, robes, vambraces, leggings and shoes.

==Armor bonuses==
[[Basic armor|Basic]] Dervish armor provides up to a maximum of 70 [[Armor rating|armor]], 5 extra [[energy]], 25 extra [[health]] and 2 extra [[energy recovery]].

Other [[armor bonus]]es are available on top of these basic stats either as an attribute bonus, an [[insignia#Dervish|insignia]], or a [[rune]].

== Beta armor ==
In the video documentary '''Making of Guild Wars Nightfall''' available in the [https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Guild_Wars_Nightfall#Guild_Wars_Nightfall_Collector's_Edition_(box_content) Collector's Edition], starting at minute 04:36 and 10:17, a beta version of a female Dervish armor can be seen in motion. This preliminary version combines elements that appeared in the final versions:
* Head: Sunspear + Primeval + Elonian (''F'')
* Chest: Elonian (''F'')
* Hands: Istani + Elonian (''F'')
* Legs: Elonian (''M'')
* Shoes: Elonian (''F'')
